vDSP_optimizations.notes: Uses vDSP deinterleave function which is heavily optimized for ARM NEON/AMX. Also eliminates temporary array allocations for leftChannel/rightChannel by using pre-allocated vDSP buffers.

vDSP_optimizations.optimized: Use vDSP_vadd for pairwise channel mixing with recursive reduction
vDSP_optimizations.notes: For >2 channels, use vDSP_vadd to accumulate channels pairwise, then vDSP_vsmul for scaling. Consider creating a channel-mixing matrix with vDSP_mmov for >4 channels.

vDSP_optimizations.optimized: vDSP_mmul with mixing matrix OR vDSP_vadd pairwise for stereo
vDSP_optimizations.notes: Primary optimization: use vDSP matrix multiply with [1/N, 1/N, ...] mixing vector. For stereo specifically, vDSP_vadd + vDSP_vsmul is optimal.

vDSP_optimizations.optimized: vDSP_vadd + vDSP_vsmul for stereo, vDSP_mmov for matrix transpose then vDSP_sve
vDSP_optimizations.notes: Hot path in audio resampling. Use vDSP for channel summation. Consider pre-transposing channel data with vDSP_mmov for better cache locality.

memory_optimizations.speedup: Eliminates quadratic behavior - O(n) per chunk becomes O(1)
memory_optimizations.notes: CRITICAL: This is called in the hot VAD processing loop. Current O(n) shift on every VAD chunk causes O(n²) total behavior for long streams. With 16kHz audio and 4096-sample VAD chunks, at 30 seconds this creates ~30,000 element shifts per chunk.

memory_optimizations.current: speechSamples unbounded growth with array copies for partial transcription
memory_optimizations.speedup: Eliminates full array copies (~10-100x faster for long segments)
memory_optimizations.notes: Current code copies speechSamples array every 400ms for partial transcription. At 30 seconds of speech, this is a 480,000 element copy (~2MB) every 400ms. Use chunked storage with copy-on-read.

memory_optimizations.optimized_code:
samples.withUnsafeBufferPointer { source in
    resampled.withUnsafeMutableBufferPointer { target in
        vDSP_vlint(
            source.baseAddress!,
            [Float(ratio)],
            1,
            target.baseAddress!,
            1,
            vDSP_Length(targetCount),
            &sourceLength
        )
    }
}
memory_optimizations.notes: WhisperKitAudioProcessor already uses vDSP_vlint correctly at lines 105-117. MLXAudioProcessor should adopt the same pattern.

apple_silicon_optimizations.description: Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3 have dedicated AMX (Apple Matrix Extensions) coprocessors that accelerate vDSP operations automatically. All vDSP functions route to AMX when available.
apple_silicon_optimizations.implementation: Use Accelerate.framework consistently. No special code needed - vDSP automatically uses AMX on Apple Silicon.

apple_silicon_optimizations.opportunity: Neural Engine for ML Audio Preprocessing
apple_silicon_optimizations.description: Consider using Core ML for audio preprocessing pipelines if converting to MLX format. Can offload to ANE for batch operations.
apple_silicon_optimizations.implementation: Create Core ML model for: normalize -> deinterleave -> mix -> resample pipeline
apple_silicon_optimizations.speedup: 10-20x for batch processing, but overhead makes it slower for real-time chunks

apple_silicon_optimizations.description: Line 514-540 downmix could use vDSP_mmov to transpose channels before summing for better cache locality
apple_silicon_optimizations.implementation: Transpose channel-major to frame-major with vDSP_mmov, then use vDSP_sve for summation
apple_silicon_optimizations.speedup: 2-3x for multi-channel due to cache coherency
